paite: Huchi in Job in agentehna thu apan nawn a, hichi in achi:
heading: Job
english: Job again took up his parable, and said,

paite: "Pathian ahin bang in, ama'n ka dikna alamang a; Bangkim hihthei in, ama'n ka kha ahihbuaia;
english: “As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter

paite: Ka sung a ka hinna a-om lai teng, Pathian hu ka nakvang a a-om lai teng?
english: (for the length of my life is still in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils);

paite: Ka mukte'n thutak lou agen kei ding, ka lei in leng khemna thu agen kei ding.
english: surely my lips will not speak unrighteousness, neither will my tongue utter deceit.

paite: Siam ka hon tangsak kei ding a, ka sih ma kei a pan ka dikna ka koihmang kei ding.
english: Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.

paite: Ka diktatna ka len tinten a, ka khah kei ding hi, ka dam lai teng ka lungtang in kei hon kou kei ding.
english: I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart will not reproach me so long as I live.

paite: "Ka melma gilou bang hi henla, kei dou ding a thou midiktat lou bang hi hen.
english: “Let my enemy be as the wicked. Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.

paite: Punna muta mahleh, Pathian limsakloumi lametna, Pathian in akha alakmang ngal in, bang ahia?
english: For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?

paite: Atung a buaina atun in, Pathian in akikou aza diam?
english: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?

paite: Bangkim hihthei ah nuam asa in, chik lai peuh in Pathian sap nuam asa diam?
english: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?

paite: "Pathian khut tungtang ah nang ka hon sinsak ding; Bangkim hihthei kiang a om ke'n ka iim kei ding hi.
english: I will teach you about the hand of God. I will not conceal that which is with the Almighty.

paite: Ngai un, noute tengteng in huai na muta ua; ahih ngalleh, bangziak a bangmah lou hong hi na hi ua?"
english: Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?

paite: "Hiai Pathian lak a migilou tantuan leh, nuaisiah hat mite goutan, Bangkim hihthei a pan amuh uh ahi.
heading: Zophar
english: “This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.

paite: Atate apun uleh, namsau a ding ahi; huan asuan tanghou in atai kei ding hi.
english: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring will not be satisfied with bread.

paite: Anung a omlaite hi leng in avui dia, ameithaite un kahna abawl kei ding uh.
english: Those who remain of him will be buried in death. His widows will make no lamentation.

paite: Leivui bang a dangka vum in, tungman bang in puansilh bawl mahleh;
english: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;

paite: Abawl thei, himahleh midikte'n asilh ding ua, mihoihte'n dangka pen ahawm ding uh.
english: he may prepare it, but the just will put it on, and the innocent will divide the silver.

paite: Maimomlen bang in inn alam a, vengmi in abawl aidakbuk bang lel ahi.
english: He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.

paite: Hausa in alum a, himahleh khop in a-om kei ding; amit ahak a, huan amah a-om kei.
english: He lies down rich, but he will not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.

paite: Tuite bang in launate'n amah apha a; zan in huihpi in amah agumang hi.
english: Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night.

paite: Suahlam huih in amah apomang a, apaimang hi; huchi in amun a kipan in amah amutmang hi.
english: The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.

paite: "Pathian in amah nakpi in alawn dia, adawm kei ding; akhut a pan ataimang ding hi.
english: For it hurls at him, and does not spare, as he flees away from his hand.

paite: Mite'n amah akhut uh abetkhum ding ua, amun a kipan in amah anuihsan ding uhi."
english: Men will clap their hands at him, and will hiss him out of his place.
